import numpy as np
z=np.load("work/clip_scores.npz",allow_pickle=True); S=z["S"]; labels=list(z["labels"]); times=z["times"]
for li,lab in enumerate(labels):
    s=S[:,li]; order=np.argsort(-s)
    picks=[]
    for i in order:
        t=times[i]
        if all(abs(t-p)>12 for p in picks): picks.append(t)
        if len(picks)>=8: break
    print(f"=== {lab}")
    print(" ".join(f"{int(t//60)}:{t%60:04.1f}({s[int(t/2)]:.3f})" for t in picks))
import wave,numpy as np,sys
start=float(sys.argv[1]); end=float(sys.argv[2])
w=wave.open("work/audio48k.wav","rb"); sr=w.getframerate(); nch=w.getnchannels(); f0=int(start*sr); n=int((end-start)*sr); w.setpos(f0); x=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(n),dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32)/32768
if nch==2: x=x.reshape(-1,2).mean(1)
N=1024;H=128;win=np.hanning(N)
frames=1+(len(x)-N)//H; S=np.empty((frames,N//2+1),np.float32)
for i in range(frames): S[i]=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x[i*H:i*H+N]*win))
f=np.fft.rfftfreq(N,1/sr); Sdb=20*np.log10(S+1e-7)
flux=np.maximum(0,np.diff(S,axis=0)).sum(1)
thr=flux.mean()+2*flux.std(); peaks=[]
for i in range(1,len(flux)-1):
    if flux[i]>thr and flux[i]>=flux[i-1] and flux[i]>=flux[i+1]: peaks.append(i)
merged=[]
for i in peaks:
    if merged and (i-merged[-1])*H/sr<0.08:
        if flux[i]>flux[merged[-1]]: merged[-1]=i
    else: merged.append(i)
for i in sorted(merged,key=lambda i:-flux[i])[:25]:
    t=start+i*H/sr; spec=S[i]
    e_low=spec[(f>200)&(f<2000)].sum(); e_mid=spec[(f>=2000)&(f<6000)].sum(); e_hi=spec[(f>=6000)&(f<16000)].sum()
    cent=(spec*f).sum()/spec.sum()
    # decay: energy in next 30ms vs peak frame
    j=min(frames-1,i+10); dec=20*np.log10((S[j].sum()+1e-9)/(spec.sum()+1e-9))
    print(f"t={t:.3f} flux={flux[i]:.0f} cent={cent:.0f} hi/mid={e_hi/(e_mid+1e-9):.2f} decay30={dec:.0f}dB")
import sys, wave, numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
start=float(sys.argv[1]); end=float(sys.argv[2]); out=sys.argv[3]; ch=int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv)>4 else None
w=wave.open("work/audio6ch.wav","rb"); sr=w.getframerate(); nch=w.getnchannels(); sw=w.getsampwidth()
f0=int(start*sr); n=int((end-start)*sr); w.setpos(f0); data=w.readframes(n)
x=np.frombuffer(data,dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32)/32768.0
if nch>1:
    x=x.reshape(-1,nch)
    x=x[:,ch] if ch is not None else x.mean(1)
# STFT
N=1024; H=256
frames=1+(len(x)-N)//H
win=np.hanning(N).astype(np.float32)
S=np.empty((frames,N//2+1),np.float32)
for i in range(frames):
    seg=x[i*H:i*H+N]*win
    S[i]=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg))
freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(N,1/sr)
Sdb=20*np.log10(S+1e-6)
# flux high band 1.5-10k
mask=(freqs>=1500)&(freqs<=10000)
flux=np.maximum(0,np.diff(S[:,mask],axis=0)).sum(1)
# RMS
rms=np.sqrt(np.convolve(x*x,np.ones(480)/480,'same'))
# image
W=1600; Hh=700
img=Image.new('RGB',(W,Hh),(15,15,15)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
font=ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf",14)
def xpix(t): return int((t-start)/(end-start)*(W-60))+50
# waveform panel
mid=110; amp=70
d.line([50,mid,W-10,mid],fill=(80,80,80))
step=max(1,len(x)//(W-60))
for px in range(W-60):
    i0=px*step; seg=x[i0:i0+step]
    if len(seg)==0: break
    lo=seg.min(); hi=seg.max()
    d.line([50+px,mid-int(hi*amp),50+px,mid-int(lo*amp)],fill=(100,200,255))
# spectrogram 150-600
for t in range(int(start),int(end)+1):
    xx=xpix(t); d.line([xx,150,xx,600],fill=(50,50,50)); d.text((xx+2,152),f"{t//60}:{t%60:02d}",font=font,fill=(150,150,150))
# downsample spectrogram to width
for px in range(W-60):
    i0=int(px/(W-60)*frames); i1=max(i0+1,int((px+1)/(W-60)*frames))
    col=Sdb[i0:i1].mean(0)
    for fy in range(150,600):
        fi=int((600-fy)/450*(len(col)-1))
        v=col[fi]; vv=max(0,min(255,int((v+70)*255/70)))
        d.point((50+px,fy),fill=(vv, vv, 120 if vv>200 else vv))
# flux
fmax=max(1,flux.max())
for px in range(W-60):
    i0=min(frames-1,int(px/(W-60)*frames)); i1=max(i0+1,int((px+1)/(W-60)*frames))
    v=flux[i0:min(i1,len(flux))].max()/fmax if i0<len(flux) else 0
    d.line([50+px,690-int(v*70),50+px,690],fill=(255,160,0))
img.save(out)
# peaks
thr=flux.mean()+2.5*flux.std()
peaks=[]
for i in range(1,len(flux)-1):
    if flux[i]>thr and flux[i]>=flux[i-1] and flux[i]>=flux[i+1]:
        peaks.append((start+(i+1)*H/sr,flux[i]))
# merge within 60ms
merged=[]
for t,v in peaks:
    if merged and t-merged[-1][0]<0.06:
        if v>merged[-1][1]: merged[-1]=(t,v)
    else: merged.append((t,v))
print("flux threshold",round(float(thr),2))
for t,v in sorted(merged,key=lambda z:-z[1])[:30]:
    print(round(t,3), round(float(v),1))

import sys, os, subprocess, math, shutil
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
start=float(sys.argv[1]); end=float(sys.argv[2]); fps=float(sys.argv[3]); width=int(sys.argv[4]); cols=int(sys.argv[5]); out=sys.argv[6]
tmp="work/_tmpframes"
shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs(tmp)
dur=max(0.04,end-start)
subprocess.run(["ffmpeg","-hide_banner","-loglevel","error","-ss",str(start),"-i","film.mp4","-t",str(dur),"-vf",f"fps={fps},scale={width}:-2","-q:v","2",os.path.join(tmp,"f_%06d.jpg"),"-y"],check=True)
files=sorted(os.listdir(tmp))
font=ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf",14)
im0=Image.open(os.path.join(tmp,files[0])); w,h=im0.size
rows=math.ceil(len(files)/cols)
sheet=Image.new("RGB",(w*cols,(h+18)*rows),(20,20,20)); d=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
for i,f in enumerate(files):
    im=Image.open(os.path.join(tmp,f)).convert("RGB"); r=i//cols; c=i%cols; x=c*w; y=r*(h+18)
    t=start+i/fps
    sheet.paste(im,(x,y)); d.text((x+3,y+h+1),f"{int(t//60):02d}:{t%60:05.2f}",font=font,fill=(255,220,0))
sheet.save(out,quality=88)
print(out,len(files),w,h)

import os, csv, time
model=YOLO(\"yolo11n.pt\")

w=csv.writer(out); w.writerow([\"idx\",\"t\",\"cls\",\"conf\",\"x1\",\"y1\",\"x2\",\"y2\"])

    if n%100==0:
        out.flush(); print(n, f, time.time()-t0, flush=True)
out.close(); print(\"done\", time.time()-t0)

import wave,numpy as np,sys
start=float(sys.argv[1]); end=float(sys.argv[2]); ch=int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else None
w=wave.open(\"work/audio6ch.wav\",\"rb\"); sr=w.getframerate(); nch=w.getnchannels(); w.setpos(int(start*sr)); n=int((end-start)*sr)
x=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(n),dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32)/32768
x=x.reshape(-1,nch); x=x[:,ch] if ch is not None else x.mean(1)
N=1024;H=256;win=np.hanning(N)
frames=1+(len(x)-N)//H
S=np.empty((frames,N//2+1),np.float32)
for i in range(frames): S[i]=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x[i*H:i*H+N]*win))
f=np.fft.rfftfreq(N,1/sr)
band=((f>=2500)&(f<=12000))
e=S[:,band].sum(1)
# robust threshold
med=np.median(e); mad=np.median(np.abs(e-med)); thr=med+8*mad
peaks=[]
for i in range(2,len(e)-2):
    if e[i]>thr and e[i]>=e[i-1] and e[i]>=e[i+1]: peaks.append(i)
# merge within 80ms
merged=[]
for i in peaks:
    if merged and (i-merged[-1])*H/sr<0.08:
        if e[i]>e[merged[-1]]: merged[-1]=i
    else: merged.append(i)
print(\"thr\",thr,\"med\",med,\"frames\",frames)
for i in merged:
    t=start+i*H/sr
    # centroid
    spec=S[i]; cent=(spec*f).sum()/spec.sum()
    print(f\"{t:.3f} e={e[i]:.1f} cent={cent:.0f} dur_ms={1000*H/sr:.0f}\")

 "seabirds flying over the sea","birds flying in the sky over water","a pressure gauge on industrial pipes","industrial pipes and valves","a film projector with reels","a slide projector in a dark room","a hand loading a slide into a projector","a photograph of people by the sea","a wooden pier over water","a metal tray on a balance scale in a kitchen","a glass bowl full of ice cubes","a hand reaching into a bucket of ice","a spider web covered with dew","moss and lichen on tree bark","an angle grinder cutting metal with sparks","a cocktail shaker on a bar counter","a beer bottle in a man's hand","a kitchen gas stove burner with blue flame","a telephone handset in a control room","two men fighting in a bar","a car crashing into trees","rain on a car windshield","a hand turning a car radio knob","a hand pulling a car handbrake"
]
with torch.no_grad():
    te=m.get_text_features(**p(text=labels,return_tensors="pt",padding=True)).pooler_output; te=te/te.norm(dim=-1,keepdim=True)
allsc=[]
t0=time.time()
for start in range(0,len(files),64):
    ims=[Image.open(f).convert("RGB") for f in files[start:start+64]]
    inp=p(images=ims,return_tensors="pt")
    with torch.no_grad():
        fe=m.get_image_features(**inp).pooler_output; fe=fe/fe.norm(dim=-1,keepdim=True)
    allsc.append((fe@te.T).numpy())
    if start%320==0: print(start, round(time.time()-t0,1), flush=True)
S=np.concatenate(allsc,0)
np.savez("work/clip_scores.npz",S=S,labels=np.array(labels),times=np.arange(len(files))*2.0)
print("done",S.shape,time.time()-t0,flush=True)

import torch, glob, time, numpy as np, json
from PIL import Image
from transformers import CLIPModel, CLIPProcessor
m=CLIPModel.from_pretrained("openai/clip-vit-base-patch32").eval()
p=CLIPProcessor.from_pretrained("openai/clip-vit-base-patch32")
files=sorted(glob.glob("work/frames2/*.jpg"))
labels=[
 "seabirds flying over the sea","birds flying in the sky over water","a pressure gauge on industrial pipes","industrial pipes and valves","a film projector with reels","a slide projector in a dark room","a hand loading a slide into a projector","a photograph of people by the sea","a wooden pier over water","a metal tray on a balance scale in a kitchen","a glass bowl full of ice cubes","a hand reaching into a bucket of ice","a spider web covered with dew","moss and lichen on tree bark","an angle grinder cutting metal with sparks","a cocktail shaker on a bar counter","a beer bottle in a man's hand","a kitchen gas stove burner with blue flame","a telephone handset in a control room","two men fighting in a bar","a car crashing into trees","rain on a car windshield","a hand turning a car radio knob","a hand pulling a car handbrake"
]
with torch.no_grad():
    te=m.get_text_features(**p(text=labels,return_tensors="pt",padding=True)).pooler_output; te=te/te.norm(dim=-1,keepdim=True)
allsc=[]
t0=time.time()
for start in range(0,len(files),64):
    ims=[Image.open(f).convert("RGB") for f in files[start:start+64]]
    inp=p(images=ims,return_tensors="pt")
    with torch.no_grad():
        fe=m.get_image_features(**inp).pooler_output; fe=fe/fe.norm(dim=-1,keepdim=True)
    allsc.append((fe@te.T).numpy())
    if start%320==0: print(start, round(time.time()-t0,1), flush=True)
S=np.concatenate(allsc,0)
np.savez("work/clip_scores.npz",S=S,labels=np.array(labels),times=np.arange(len(files))*2.0)
print("done",S.shape,time.time()-t0,flush=True)
